'''House Vostovan''' is one of the known [[Nobility|noble]] [[House]]s of [[Arafel]].

The only known member of the House is [[Sarainya Vostovan]]. She went to the [[White Tower]] and trained as a [[novice]] for ten years, but was only raised to [[Accepted]] for political reasons, and was sent away immediately after as she was too weak in ''[[saidar]]'' to test for [[Aes Sedai]]. Instead of rejoining her family, she joined the [[Kin]] in [[Ebou Dar]].
